Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular houseplant options are the Pothos (like the Marble Queen 6" for $27.99) and the Snake Plant (like the Sanseviera Lauren 10" for $40.99).
Here is how they compare to help you choose what fits best:
• Pothos: A trailing, vining plant that adapts well to almost any indoor lighting (from low light to bright indirect light). It prefers its soil surface to dry between waterings and is great if you want lush, draping foliage.
• Snake Plant: An upright, architectural plant that is extremely low-maintenance and forgiving. It thrives on neglect, tolerates very low light to bright indirect light, and prefers to dry out completely between waterings. It is also listed by NASA for its air-purifying qualities.
If you want a plant you barely need to water that stays upright and compact, the Snake Plant is ideal. If you prefer lush, cascading vines that grow quickly, the Pothos is your best choice!
